# Stake Platform Requirements

<!-- Generated by Copilot -->
_Source: https://stake-engine.com/docs — Last updated: 2026-06-05_

---

## Platform Overview
- **Platform name:** Stake Engine
- **Backend server:** Carrot RGS (Remote Gaming Server)
- **Submission portal:** Admin Control Panel (ACP) at stake-engine.com
- **Games publish to:** Stake.com and Stake.us (auto-qualified if language requirements met)

---

## File Format & Architecture

> **Critical concept:** All game outcomes must be **pre-simulated** and stored as static files. There is no live RNG at runtime.

- **Game architecture:** Fully stateless. Each bet is independent — no jackpots, gamble features, continuation rounds, or early cashout.
- **Submission format:** Static files uploaded to ACP, compressed by bet mode
- **Outcome mapping:** Each outcome maps to a CSV with `simulation_number`, `probability_weight`, and `payout_multiplier`
- **Runtime flow:** Player bets → server picks a simulation number proportionally → returns pre-computed result via `/play` API

---

## Technical Specs

- **Mobile support:** Required — URL passes `device=mobile` or `device=desktop` param
- **Languages supported:** 17 languages via ISO 639-1 `lang` URL param (ar, de, en, es, fi, fr, hi, id, ja, ko, pl, pt, ru, tr, vi, zh, da)
- **Game URL structure:**
  ```
  https://{{TeamName}}.cdn.stake-engine.com/{{GameID}}/{{GameVersion}}/index.html
  ?sessionID=...&lang=...&device=...&rgs_url=...
  ```

---

## API Flow (every game must implement)

1. On game load → `POST /wallet/authenticate` (validates sessionID)
2. Player bets → `POST /wallet/play`
3. Animate result
4. Round ends → `POST /wallet/end-round`

**Key error codes:**
| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| ERR_IS | Invalid/expired session |
| ERR_IPB | Insufficient player balance |
| ERR_GLE | Gambling limits exceeded |
| ERR_LOC | Invalid player location |

---

## Game Requirements

- **Game type:** Slot-focused platform (other game types possible but SDK is slot-oriented)
- **Stateless requirement:** Strictly enforced — no jackpots, no gamble features, no cashout, no continuation
- **Originality:** Must be original. No pre-purchased or licensed games from other platforms
- **RTP range:** Not publicly specified — defined in math simulation files per game

### Bet Levels
- **Min bet:** Must support small denominations — `$0.01, $0.02, $0.05, $0.10, ...`
- **Max bet:** Up to `$1000` (1,000,000,000 units)
- **Bet rules:** Must fall between `minBet` and `maxBet`; must be divisible by `stepBet` (returned from `/wallet/authenticate`)
- **Bet modes:** Games may have multiple bet modes with cost multipliers

---

## Currency Handling

- **Money format:** Integers with 6 decimal places of precision
  - $1.00 = `1000000` | $0.10 = `100000` | $0.01 = `10000`
- **Currency affects display only** — game logic is currency-agnostic
- **Supported currencies:** 30+ fiat currencies (USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, BRL, etc.)
- **Social casino currencies:** XGC (Gold Coins), XSC (Stake Cash) for Stake.us
- **Win display precision:** 3 decimal places if min win ≥ 0.1x; 4 decimal places if min win < 0.1x (required for small bets)

---

## Branding & Assets

- **Stake branding:** Game assets **cannot** include Stake™ branding or themes
- **IP/copyright:** Team names, game titles, and assets must not infringe on any IP
- **Prohibited content:** Offensive, explicit, or poor-taste content rejected at reviewer discretion. No content appealing to minors.

### Mandatory Game Tile Assets (required per submission)
All three must be submitted with every game:

| Asset | Spec | Naming |
|-------|------|--------|
| Background image | High-res PNG or JPG, shows game world | `GameTitle-BG.png` |
| Foreground image | High-res PNG, transparent background, key character/item | `GameTitle-FG.png` |
| Provider logo | High-res PNG, transparent background | `ProviderName-Logo.png` |

- BG + FG combined must be **under 3MB**

---

## Mandatory Technical Features

### Bet Replay (required — games will not be approved without it)
- Games must accept replay query params: `replay=true`, `game`, `version`, `mode`, `event`, `rgs_url`
- Must fetch replay state from: `GET {rgs_url}/bet/replay/{game}/{version}/{mode}/{event}`
- No active session needed to view replay (URLs are publicly shareable)
- All betting UI must be **disabled** in replay mode
- Must show: loading state → Play button → full animation → results → Play Again button

---

## Language / Jurisdiction (Stake.us)

Games auto-qualify for Stake.us but must swap gambling terminology via a `sweeps_<lang>` language file:

| Prohibited | Replace with |
|-----------|-------------|
| bet / bets | play / plays |
| wager | play |
| cash | coins |
| win feature | play feature |
| buy bonus | get bonus |
| deposit | get coins |
| withdraw | redeem |
| gamble | play |
| total bet | total play |

---

## Submission Process

- **Portal:** ACP at stake-engine.com — team **maxiai** registered ✅
- **ACP URL pattern:** `stake-engine.com/teams/maxiai/games/{game}/...`
- **Review:** 3 independent reviewers (ratings hidden from each other)
  - Average **≥ 2.0 stars** → enters full review process
  - Average **< 2.0 stars** → not published — can resubmit within **3 days** after fixing issues
- **Review timeline:**
  1. Submit → rating queue (≤24 hours for all 3 ratings)
  2. If ≥ 2.0 avg → reviewer contacts you within a couple of days to begin full review
  3. Back-and-forth with reviewer until checklist complete → approved → live within 24h (usually hours)
- **Required with every submission:** Short blurb describing game theme and mechanics
- **Post-approval:** Only minor visual fixes allowed — math and mechanics are locked

### Pre-Submission Checklist (ACP blocks submission until all pass)
- [ ] **Thumbnail uploaded** — via ACP game thumbnail page
- [ ] **Frontend version published** — at least one version uploaded to ACP files
- [ ] **Math version published** — at least one version uploaded to ACP files
- [ ] **Math validation passed** — all game modes must pass RTP, hit-rate, and max-win checks

### Payout Details
- Payouts processed monthly — accounting closes at UTC midnight
- Invoice appears on payments page confirming the amount
- Funds sent to wallet within **12 hours** of invoice
- **Wallet address must be set** — if no wallet configured, balance carries over to next month
- Dashboard shows performance data; accounting updated every **5 minutes**

---

## Quality Rankings (determines visibility on platform)

| Stars | Bar | Placement |
|-------|-----|-----------|
| ★★★ | Studio quality, exceptional creativity | Featured, Burst Games, Stake Exclusives, New Releases |
| ★★ | Strong quality, some originality | New Releases, Burst/Exclusives if popular |
| ★ | Meets minimum but low polish | **Not published** — sent back for improvements |

**Common rejection reasons:**
- Shallow gameplay — players lose interest in 1–2 bets
- Generic AI assets (stock gradients, emoji icons, generic fonts)
- No bonus modes or extra mechanics
- Inconsistent or mismatched art styles
